scope: Reviewed explicit local dependency purposes; entries may be noncyclic. No claim of dynamic dependency completeness or approval of arbitrary new cycles.

rationales._circuit->_ergonomics: Facade delegates ordered construction, binding, evolution and derivatives to private planners; planners instantiate/check the same Circuit.
rationales._circuit->_classical: Explicit dynamic/noisy/density execution delegates to native integration, not another facade.
rationales._circuit->_transpilation: Explicit transformations and synthesis return the same native-backed Circuit.
rationales._circuit->_contracts: Facade constructs a bounded immutable predicate contract.
rationales._circuit->_plan: Facade constructs an explicit independent query plan.
rationales._circuit->_reports: Facade returns legacy-compatible typed semantic diff report.
rationales._circuit->_inspection: Facade delegates explicit inspection, not execution.
rationales._circuit->_execution: Facade delegates ideal evolution to private execution.
rationales._ergonomics->_circuit: Private planner checks exact facade type or constructs independent staged Circuit.
rationales._ergonomics->_observable: Private math planner checks supported immutable observable expressions.
rationales._result->_inspection: Snapshot delegates evidence and verification presentation.
rationales._result->_observable: Snapshot evaluates existing immutable observable type.
rationales._result->_contracts: Snapshot constructs/verifies contract without implicit rerun.
rationales._statistical->_reports: Statistical verdict is exposed as existing typed report.
rationales._checks->_circuit: Verification validates/constructs reference Circuit without eager initialization.
rationales._checks->_reports: Verification returns existing typed report schemas.
rationales._checks->_external: Optional explicit external verification is imported only on use.
rationales._trace->_circuit: Trace validates reference Circuit and explicit execution scope.
rationales._trace->_reports: Trace returns bounded typed diagnostic report.
rationales._trace->_contracts: Trace evaluates existing contract, not a new predicate engine.
rationales._verification->_circuit: Verification validates exact circuit types and constructs bounded witnesses.
rationales._external->_circuit: External adapter validates circuit types before optional native execution.
rationales._transpilation->_circuit: Native synthesis/lowering constructs the single existing facade.
rationales._transpilation->_observable: Native Hamiltonian synthesis checks existing immutable expression.
rationales._plan->_circuit: Query plan owns independently admitted native-backed Circuit.
rationales._reports->_verification: Report explicitly reconstructs bounded Evidence from existing validation.
rationales._resources->_visualization: Resource presentation delegates explicit SVG export.
rationales._algorithms->_observable: Algorithm factory constructs existing immutable Observable.
rationales._classical->_adapter: Dynamic path delegates native gate admission.
rationales._adapter->_gate_specs: Native admission consults foundational gate registry.
